audit.whatIsWrong: The page's focus ability is 'Repeating Dashes' — that is not an Ambessa ability. Her dash is the passive Drakehound's Step; her spells are Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R).
audit.why: The whole page told the player to 'track Repeating Dashes' — a name that does not exist in game, so there is nothing to track. Worse, the real mechanic is not a cooldown at all: Drakehound's Step triggers off casting an ability, so the thing to watch is her spell usage, not a dash timer.
audit.corrected: focus.text, tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, dosFull[0], breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t rebuilt on Drakehound's Step and on the rule that a spent spell is a spent dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the level-6 spike was described only as 'her W burst and chain CC'.
audit.why: Q 14s, W 18s, E 13s at rank 1 are the timers that gate her dash; Public Execution is 130s at rank 1 and blinks to the farthest enemy in a line, suppresses, then stuns.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Q/W/E and the 130s Nature's Grasp; mid states the blink-and-suppress shape of her R.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late were written in first person ('the window I actually own'), unlike the rest of the site.
audit.why: The page speaks to the player in second person everywhere else; the voice break is jarring and reads like notes, not coaching.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten in second person at the same length, with the real ability names in place.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are the window I actually own. At Level 1 I only have one ability so I respect her, but once I complete W into Q I can root her, knock her back, and proc Sap Magic to heal the trade right back — she can't out-poke my sustain yet and her dash chain isn't fully online. The key is landing W when her mobility dash is on cooldown; if she has it up she'll weave out of my Q and punish my whiff. Drop E saplings on the wave so she can't dance around me freely.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are the window you actually own. At Level 1 you have one ability so respect her, but once W and Q are both up you root her, knock her back, and proc Sap Magic to heal the trade right back — she can't out-poke your sustain yet and her spells are still on long ranks. The key is landing W on a spent cast: Drakehound's Step only fires off an ability, so a whiffed Cunning Sweep is a whiffed dash. Sapling the wave so she can't weave freely.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay mine — my root and Sap Magic cooldowns let me repeat the W-Q-heal trade and grind her down. Then Level 6 flips hard: her R Public Execution plus her W burst and chain CC make her all-in far scarier than my R, which is engage utility, not a 1v1 button. Do not duel her once she has ult unless I've already burned her dashes. Bait her dash, W her when she lands, and disengage before her full combo lands.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours — your root is 11s by rank 4 and Sap Magic keeps refilling, so you repeat the W-Q-heal trade. Then 6 flips hard: Public Execution blinks to the farthest enemy in a line, suppresses, then stuns, which beats your R as a 1v1 button outright. Don't duel her with it up unless her spells are spent. Bait a cast, W her as she lands, and leave before Repudiation comes back.

edits.before: In a straight 1v1 she out-scales me — her bruiser items keep her damage climbing while mine flatlines, so I lose the extended fight every time once she's got two items. My value shifts entirely to teamfights: R Nature's Grasp catches her whole team, my W peels for my carries, and saplings zone chokes. Never splitpush into her alone. Group, use my CC to lock her down for my damage dealers, and let the team punish the dive she keeps trying.
edits.after: In a straight 1v1 she out-scales you — her bruiser items keep her damage climbing while yours flatlines, so you lose the extended fight once she has two items. Your value shifts entirely to teamfights: Nature's Grasp catches her whole team, W peels for your carries, and saplings zone the chokes. Never splitpush into her alone. Group, lock her down for your damage dealers, and let the team punish the dive she keeps trying.
